retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, cool-toned group portrait set on a vast frozen landscape with an arched title and distant urban horizon.

recipe.visualDefinition: A wide-angle photograph of a group of people standing on a textured frozen surface, featuring a hazy city skyline in the far background and stylized, arched text floating in the upper sky area.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered in the middle ground against a vast white expanse
Arched typography mirroring the curve of the horizon or sky
Distant skyline providing a sense of scale and location
Cool, monochromatic color palette unifying the subjects and environment
coreInvariants: Arched text placement in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of seven figures arranged in a loose, staggered formation in the center and middle ground, occupying about 40% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a long coat and hat acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the arched text at the top, moves down to the central group, and then follows the horizon line to the distant city.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space provided by the white frozen ground in the foreground and the hazy sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal and black (clothing of the subjects)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-value background and low-value subjects creating a silhouette-like effect.

letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded strokes with a slight calligraphic lean
Heavy drop shadows or outlines to create depth
Letters follow a distinct upward arching baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Snow-capped effect on the top edges of letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face used for both title and subtitle to maintain stylistic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and rounded 70s feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a group of men in 1970s winter coats standing on a vast, textured frozen lake. In the far distance, a hazy, desaturated city skyline is visible under a pale grey sky. The overall image should have a cool blue-grey tint and high-key lighting on the ice.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, rounded script text in the upper sky area. The text must be arched upwards. Apply a dark fill with white highlights on the top edges of the letters to simulate snow resting on them.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette monochromatic blue-grey?
Are the subjects standing on a frozen surface?
Is there a distant city skyline?

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
Specific brand names in the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ice texture looks realistic and cold
Verify the 'snow-capped' effect on the lettering
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Group Portrait + Frozen Landscape + Arched Display Type + Cool Monochrome Tint
